verdict.rationale: Better Auth's MCP plugin explicitly implements OAuth authorization server + protected resource semantics for MCP clients, giving spec-compliant scoped/verifiable token flows in front of an MCP server, and this is corroborated by a live probe hitting a real MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) confirmation of a full end-to-end scoped-token consumer flow rather than docs/probe only.
